lines.say: Why do you feel sick after leg day?
Why does this happen, number ten.
Your legs are your biggest muscles. During hard sets, they pull a huge amount of blood.
So your stomach and gut get less blood, and they don't like it.
Then you finish the set and just stop. Blood pools in your legs, your blood pressure dips, and you feel dizzy and sick.
Holding your breath on heavy reps, and training on a full stomach, make it worse.
The fix: walk around between sets, keep breathing, eat one or two hours before, and cool down slowly.
If you faint, or get chest pain, stop and get checked.
